record.decision: Freeze SW10_S2_B5_PREFLIGHT_V1 before any independent validation outcomes are inspected. B5 preflight will inventory and certify genuinely independent, semantically compatible data for the nine B4 seed cases grouped into three hypothesis families; it will measure only data provenance, temporal/non-overlap independence, point-in-time semantic reproducibility, coverage, eligibility, and prospective validation feasibility. It must not compute or inspect forward outcomes, effect sizes, p-values, profitability, or protected holdout outcomes.
record.evidence: B4 completion and verified control-plane state; no independent validation outcomes inspected for this decision.

preflight_requirements: inventory candidate independent datasets and exact provenance
prove no temporal overlap with B4 discovery outcomes for any proposed validation observation
certify frozen B4 factor/proxy semantics can be reproduced without drift
certify point-in-time availability and adjustment semantics
quantify symbol/date/horizon eligibility and missingness without outcomes
audit market benchmark availability for MARKET_SPY_TREND10
recommend feasible independent validation sample(s) based only on provenance and coverage
prohibited: effect sizes, p-values, win rates, profitability or outcome-based power tuning
historical expected earnings dates treated prospectively
